name: round7_p0_diagnostic_trigger
purpose: explain why observation normalization hurts PickCube-v1
inputs: per-dimension mean/sd of the 200 training demonstrations per task
V1 floor rule as implemented: sd < 1e-6 is replaced by 1.0
z-scores over 10 episodes of one V1 checkpoint per task

trigger.part_1: any PickCube-v1 dimension with sd < 1% of the median sd across dims
trigger.part_2: > 5% of decisions with any |z| > 10 AND that fraction higher on PickCube-v1 than on the other two tasks

consequence: if triggered, train V1b (sd floored at 0.1 x the task's median sd) on PickCube-v1, 4 runs, seeds 0-3, evaluated like V1; explanatory only
